SELECT target.user_id FROM ( SELECT a.user_id FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND u.is_deleted = 0
UNION
SELECT c.user_id FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND u.is_deleted = 0 ) target ORDER BY target.user_id
